No PIPELINE commissioning year found in any asset register (SNGPL's 'Province-Wise Transmission Breakup' table, see fills[0], gives diameter/length only, no dates; SNGPL's separate 'Year Wise Increase in Transmission System' page (artids=281) gives only network-wide cumulative km totals by year, no per-segment dates, and has no hit for 'Kand Kot'/'Kandhkot'). What I DID find, per the protocol's explicit guidance on field-vs-pipeline dates: Wood Mackenzie's public 'Kandhkot Report' page states the Kandhkot GAS FIELD 'was brought onstream in 1987, almost 30 years after its discovery... mainly due to a lack of market and infrastructure required for development of the low calorific gas', and that the field 'supplies... WAPDA, Sui Southern Gas Company Limited (SSGCL), and Sui Northern Gas Pipeline Limited (SNGPL)' -- i.e. this is a commercial intelligence provider's field-level onstream date, NOT a stated pipeline commissioning date, though the passage's own framing (delay caused by lack of 'infrastructure') implies the gathering/feeder pipeline network (of which this SNGPL-owned Chachar-Kandhkot line is presumably part) was completed at or before first production. Per protocol, marking this a LOW-tier candidate rather than a confident fill, and flagging explicitly: this is a field date being used as a proxy for a pipeline date, not a literal pipeline-commissioning citation -- a human should decide whether 1987 is close enough to accept or whether to leave StartYear1 blank pending a real pipeline-specific source.
